about: Recorded from mtg-graph-api (branch dt-6.1-store; diagnose.ts, deck.ts, roles.ts unchanged from the port source rework/ts-card-graph a000f59) on the card store's inputs: the corpus, Scryfall oracle file and subtype facts cards.db was built from, mtg-vector's Tagger file, and this repo's roles.json and role-targets.json. Short-role adds are left out (the shortlist's work). Card order in the graph follows the corpus; the port's follows store ids, so compare by card name.
